Hi Lisa — Rishi here from Redwood Security. A couple of clarifications for your InfoSec reviewers:

- The attached SOC 2 report is redacted for customer distribution; if you need the full auditor version we can discuss an NDA/controlled delivery.
- Controls summary: we enforce TLS 1.2+ in transit, AES-256 at rest for customer data, role-based access controls with SSO (SAML/OIDC), and regular SOC-driven change controls. If you have specific control IDs you'd like mapped (e.g., CC6, CC7), send them and I'll map to our control evidence.
- SIG Lite: Aditya will kick off the questionnaire. Please expect initial answers within 3 business days; items requiring artifacts or security-team input may take longer.

If helpful, I can also provide a short control matrix PDF in the Trust Portal for your reviewers.

Best,
